prompts.note: XML prompts used to generate stand-in photos. Not client projects. No people, text, logos, or readable brands.

prompt.subject: Photorealistic finished residential kitchen, no people

environment.setting: US suburban home, open kitchen with a large island and three stools, warm white oak cabinets, pale quartz counters, brass faucet, plaster walls in warm cream

prompt.lighting: Soft north window light plus two linen pendants, gentle shadows, no harsh flash
prompt.composition: Wide architectural photograph, eye-level, room fills the frame, 16:9
prompt.constraints: No people, no faces, no hands, no text, no logos, no watermark, no price tags, no appliances with readable brand names
